Post for Yoga & Naturopathy Therapy Assistant
Saturday, 15 November 2025
1199 Hits
Application along with complete bio-data with necessary certificates/testimonials are invited for the following post in the Kasturba Health Society’s Department of Integrative Medicine which should reach to the office of: The Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS), 442102 latest by 29/11/2025.
Post:
Yoga & Naturopathy Therapy Assistant-2 (1 Open & 1 SC)
Qualification: 10+Therapy Assistant Training Course from National Institute of  Naturopathy or equivalent.
Experience:   2 years in Yoga Naturopathy Centre.
Pay Scale:     As per KHS Rules.
Note :
Age between 18-38 years for open category/ between 18-43 years for reserved category.
Only eligible candidates will be called for interview.
Age and experience can be relaxed for exceptional and deserving candidate.
Society reserves right to reject any or all application as deemed appropriate.
Decision of Selection Committee will be final & binding.
No TA and DA will be paid by Kasturba Health Society for attending the interview
Medical Superintendent
Kasturba Hospital
Massive Cleanliness Drive Conducted Along Sevagram...
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
